scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../media-server && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:reset: cd backend && npm run reset-dev && cd .. && npm run clean:dev
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:media-server && npm run build:frontend
scripts.desktop:restore-native: cd backend && npm rebuild better-sqlite3 bcrypt && cd ..
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npx rimraf desktop/dist || (sleep 2 && npx rimraf desktop/dist) && npm run install:all && npm run build && cd backend && npm prune --production && cd .. && npm run desktop:rebuild-native && electron-builder --mac dmg zip ; cd backend && npm install && cd .. && npm run desktop:restore-native
scripts.desktop:pack:dir: npx rimraf desktop/dist || (sleep 2 && npx rimraf desktop/dist) && npm run install:all && npm run build && cd backend && npm prune --production && cd .. && npm run desktop:rebuild-native && electron-builder --dir ; cd backend && npm install && cd .. && npm run desktop:restore-native
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npx rimraf desktop/dist || (sleep 2 && npx rimraf desktop/dist) && npm run install:all && npm run build && cd backend && npm prune --production && cd .. && npm run desktop:rebuild-native && electron-builder --win nsis ; cd backend && npm install && cd .. && npm run desktop:restore-native
